card.name: Four-colourings of complete graphs without monochromatic triangles (R(3,3,3,3))

task.name: Four-colourings of complete graphs without monochromatic triangles (R(3,3,3,3))
task.description: construct() -> {'n': n, 'colors': [...]}: one colour in {0,1,2,3} for each pair (i,j), i<j, of vertices 0..n-1 in lexicographic order, 1 <= n <= 62. No colour class may contain a triangle. Maximize n. A valid 4-colouring of K_n certifies R_4(3) > n. Chung's 50-vertex colouring is the record; 51 vertices would be new.
